title: Pianist Al Freeman and the actor Al Freeman Jr.
summary: Al Freeman, the Imperial Orchestra pianist, was the father of the actor Al Freeman Jr.

blocks.x: Okay. That gives us an idea. You mentioned that you went into the Imperial Jazz Orchestra following a piano player named Al Freeman, is that right?
And he wouldn't have been any relation to the Al Freeman, Jr. who's an actor?
I think that's his father. Al Freeman, Jr. is this Al Freeman's son.
I wondered if it might be. I mean Al Freeman is not a terribly unusual name.
Uh-huh. Uh-huh. That's his son. I think I met the actor Al Freeman, his son. I think I met him one time in New York. But that is his son. Al Freeman has passed on, the dad.
That's good to know about that relationship.
